title: 石門水庫大壩~Shihmen Dam
focus: 中央心層土石壩與排砂取水協作~Central core embankments with sediment and withdrawal functions
summary: 石門課程從中央心層、濾層、壓實與孔隙水壓開始，再把排砂、分層取水及後池調節納入水量與固體質量帳。學生練習區分土的乾密度與濕密度、濁度與含砂質量濃度，以及排水量上升與內部侵蝕證據。假想地震水平力只用於理解受力，不能替代滑動面或動力分析。~The Shihmen course begins with core zoning, filters, compaction and pore pressure, then brings sediment outlets, selective withdrawal and afterbay buffering into water and solids balances. Learners separate dry from wet density, turbidity from sediment mass concentration, and rising drainage from evidence of erosion. Hypothetical seismic inertia illustrates force bookkeeping without replacing slip-surface or dynamic analysis.
history: 北區水資源分署資料列出石門水庫一九六四年六月完成，壩高一百三十三點一公尺。官方設施介紹提供中央直立心層及後續取水排砂設施的背景，說明水庫功能會隨使用需求與泥砂問題演變。本課不以早期容量當作當前可用蓄量，也沒有把教學濾層比值寫成現地驗收規定。二〇一四年的墾務局滲流章日期屬方法文獻；與德基拱壩的比較用來辨識土石材料與混凝土傳力的不同。~The northern water authority records completion in June 1964 and height 133.1 m. Its facilities account describes the central vertical core and later withdrawal and sediment arrangements, showing how reservoir functions evolve with demand and sediment problems. Early capacity is not treated as current available storage, and illustrative filter ratios are not field acceptance requirements. The 2014 seepage chapter date belongs to a methodological reference. Comparison with Deji helps distinguish embankment behavior from concrete arch load transfer.
example: 假想兩層心層厚度各十公尺，滲透係數分別為一乘十的負七次方及五乘十的負八次方公尺每秒，串聯等效係數為六點六六七乘十的負八次方公尺每秒。水頭差三十公尺、截面一千平方公尺時，流量為零點零零零一立方公尺每秒；若低滲透層係數加倍，流量增至零點零零零一五。另以濕密度每立方公尺二千一百公斤及含水率百分之十二得乾密度一千八百七十五公斤每立方公尺，兩個計算不能替代現地壓實曲線與排水觀測。 核驗：L1=10 m; k1=1e-7 m/s; L2=10 m; k2=5e-8 m/s; A=1000 m2; dh=30 m; Q=A dh/(L1/k1+L2/k2)=0.0001 m3/s。以分層測壓點比較各層水頭損失，再用同一流量反算阻力比例。核對室內試體方向與現地壓實方向是否一致，保留溫度與飽和程度，並以排水量獨立檢查總流量而非只信等效係數。~Assume two core layers, each 10 m thick, with permeability values of 1e-7 and 5e-8 m/s. Series resistance gives an equivalent permeability of 6.667e-8 m/s. Across 30 m of head and 1000 m2 of area, flow is 0.0001 m3/s. Doubling the less permeable layer value raises flow to 0.00015 m3/s. Separately, wet density 2100 kg/m3 and gravimetric water content 0.12 imply dry density 1875 kg/m3. These results illustrate different material properties and cannot replace a compaction curve, zoning checks or drainage observations. Verification: Compare head losses across layers using piezometers and infer their resistance ratio from a common discharge. Match laboratory specimen orientation to field compaction, retain temperature and saturation information, and use measured drainage as an independent check on total flow.

units.anchor: 分層心層的串聯滲流~Series seepage through core layers
units.title: 分層心層的串聯滲流~Series seepage through core layers
units.mechanism: 中央心層靠低滲透材料限制穿壩水量，不同材料沿流向排列時，每層通過相同流量但消耗不同水頭。等效滲透係數因此是厚度加權的調和平均，較不透水的一層可能支配阻力。這與平行流路的算術平均不同，也不能把分層公式套到裂縫形成的集中流，因為後者改變流路與有效截面。~A central core limits flow with low-permeability material. Layers arranged along the flow direction carry the same discharge but consume different head losses, giving a thickness-weighted harmonic equivalent permeability. The least permeable layer can dominate resistance. This differs from parallel-path averaging and does not describe a crack carrying concentrated flow, because that feature changes both geometry and the effective flow area.
units.model: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：L1=10 m; k1=1e-7 m/s; L2=10 m; k2=5e-8 m/s; A=1000 m2; dh=30 m; Q=A dh/(L1/k1+L2/k2)=0.0001 m3/s。適用邊界：飽和一維達西流、材料均勻無裂縫，截面固定且無側向逸流。~Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: L1=10 m; k1=1e-7 m/s; L2=10 m; k2=5e-8 m/s; A=1000 m2; dh=30 m; Q=A dh/(L1/k1+L2/k2)=0.0001 m3/s. Applicable boundary: Saturated one-dimensional Darcy flow through uniform uncracked materials with constant area and no lateral escape.
units.verify: 以分層測壓點比較各層水頭損失，再用同一流量反算阻力比例。核對室內試體方向與現地壓實方向是否一致，保留溫度與飽和程度，並以排水量獨立檢查總流量而非只信等效係數。~Compare head losses across layers using piezometers and infer their resistance ratio from a common discharge. Match laboratory specimen orientation to field compaction, retain temperature and saturation information, and use measured drainage as an independent check on total flow.
units.failure: 把兩層係數直接平均會低估低滲透層的控制作用；但若低滲透層已有裂縫，仍堅持完整材料模型又會低估集中流量，兩種錯誤方向並不相同。~Arithmetic averaging underestimates control by the less permeable layer. Conversely, retaining an intact-material model after cracking can understate concentrated flow, so the two modeling errors do not share the same direction.
units.misconception: 沿流向串聯材料的係數應直接取算術平均~Permeabilities of layers in series should simply be averaged arithmetically
units.practice: 把第二層滲透係數加倍，重新求流量與兩層水頭分配，再將層厚互換比較，說明為何幾何與材料阻力必須一起記錄而不能只報一個平均係數。~Double the second permeability, recalculate discharge and head distribution, then interchange layer thicknesses. Explain why geometry and material resistance must be reported together rather than reduced to an unexplained average coefficient.

units.anchor: 濾層粒徑比例篩查~Filter gradation ratio screening
units.title: 濾層粒徑比例篩查~Filter gradation ratio screening
units.mechanism: 心層旁的濾層既要容許水排出，也要阻止細料隨流失去。粒徑分位數比例可作初步相容性討論，但其物理目的與材料分布形狀都要清楚。單一比例沒有描述間斷級配、塑性細料或施工離析，因此本課只計算幾何比值，不提供通用驗收門檻或取代專門濾層試驗。~A filter beside the core must pass water while retaining soil particles. Ratios of grain-size percentiles support preliminary compatibility discussion only when their physical purpose and the full gradation shape are understood. One ratio does not capture gap grading, plastic fines or construction segregation, so the calculation reports geometry rather than a universal acceptance threshold and does not replace a dedicated filter test.
units.model: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：D15filter=0.7 mm; d85base=0.25 mm; ratio=D15filter/d85base=2.8。適用邊界：粒徑均為重量通過百分比的同單位數據，只作比值計算，不宣告材料合格。~Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: D15filter=0.7 mm; d85base=0.25 mm; ratio=D15filter/d85base=2.8. Applicable boundary: Both percentiles use the same size unit and mass-passing convention; this is a ratio calculation, not material acceptance.
units.verify: 繪完整粒徑曲線並標明取樣位置，確認百分之十五與八十五是通過率而非留置率。比較施工前後級配與細料遷移試驗，若局部粗化或離析，應另看局部曲線，不能只用整批平均值。~Plot the complete gradation and sampling locations, confirming that fifteen and eighty-five percent denote passing rather than retained mass. Compare preconstruction and placed material with migration tests, examining local curves where segregation occurs instead of relying on a batch average.
units.failure: 把通過率與留置率顛倒會選錯粒徑；以一個看似漂亮的比值掩蓋施工離析，可能讓局部濾層過粗而失去保土功能，即使整體樣本仍維持原級配。~Reversing passing and retained percentages selects the wrong sizes. An attractive single ratio can conceal segregation that leaves local filter zones too coarse to retain soil even when the combined sample remains unchanged.
units.misconception: 只要一個粒徑比值很小就可保證濾層合格~A sufficiently small single grain-size ratio guarantees filter acceptance
units.practice: 將假想濾料離析成粗細兩區，各自重新計算比值並與合併樣本比較，提出能辨識局部風險的取樣配置，而不要自行訂定現地允許值。~Split hypothetical filter material into coarse and fine segregated zones, calculate each ratio and compare with the blended sample. Propose sampling locations that reveal local risk without inventing field acceptance limits.

units.anchor: 含水率與壓實乾密度~Water content and compacted density
units.title: 含水率與壓實乾密度~Water content and compacted density
units.mechanism: 土石壩施工控制不能只看每立方公尺濕土多重，因為其中一部分是水。以水重除乾土重定義的含水率可將濕密度換成乾密度，才便於比較固體骨架壓實程度。相同乾密度也不代表相同滲透性，因為土的組成、含水狀態、壓實能量與顆粒排列仍可能不同。~Wet bulk density alone cannot describe embankment compaction because part of the measured mass is water. Gravimetric water content, defined relative to dry solids, converts wet density to dry density for comparing the solid skeleton. Even equal dry density does not ensure equal permeability, since composition, moisture condition, compactive effort and particle arrangement may still differ substantially between specimens or placed layers.
units.model: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：rhoWet=2100 kg/m3; w=0.12 kg/kg; rhoDry=rhoWet/(1+w)=1875 kg/m3。適用邊界：含水率以乾土質量為分母，體積為原濕試體體積，無超粒徑修正。~Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: rhoWet=2100 kg/m3; w=0.12 kg/kg; rhoDry=rhoWet/(1+w)=1875 kg/m3. Applicable boundary: Water content uses dry-solid mass and density uses the original wet specimen volume, without oversize correction.
units.verify: 核對濕樣、乾樣與容器重量紀錄，將百分率轉成無因次小數後再換算。以重複試體檢查體積量測偏差，並把現地乾密度與相同材料、相同試驗能量的壓實曲線比較，避免跨材料誤比。~Check wet, dry and container masses, converting percentage to a dimensionless fraction before calculation. Use replicate specimens to assess volume error and compare field dry density with a compaction curve for the same material and test effort rather than a different soil.
units.failure: 把百分之十二直接代入十二會得到不合理低密度；若以濕土質量當含水率分母卻仍用此式，也會系統性偏差，使壓實紀錄看似精確但定義不一致。~Entering twelve instead of zero point one two produces an implausible low density. Using wet mass as the water-content denominator while retaining this equation creates a systematic definition error in otherwise precise-looking records.
units.misconception: 含水率百分之十二可直接以十二代入換算式~Twelve percent water content can be entered as twelve in the conversion
units.practice: 固定濕密度，分別用含水率百分之八與十六計算乾密度，畫出關係並說明這條換算曲線為何不是實際材料的壓實最佳含水率曲線。~At fixed wet density, calculate dry density for eight and sixteen percent water contents. Plot the conversion and explain why it is not the material's experimental optimum-moisture compaction curve.

units.anchor: 快速降水位與孔壓滯後~Drawdown and pore pressure lag
units.title: 快速降水位與孔壓滯後~Drawdown and pore pressure lag
units.mechanism: 水庫水位下降會減少上游坡面外側水壓，但心層與土體內孔壓未必同速消散，造成內外支撐條件改變。有效正向力計算能展示孔壓滯後對摩擦來源的影響；真正快速降水位問題還需土體不排水強度、滲流時程及滑動幾何，不能僅用一個力值定安全。~Falling reservoir level reduces external water support while pore pressure within embankment material may dissipate more slowly. Effective normal force illustrates how retained pressure changes the source of friction. A true rapid-drawdown assessment also requires drainage timescale, appropriate soil strength and slip geometry; a single force calculation cannot establish stability or represent the entire upstream slope during rapidly changing hydraulic and drainage conditions.
units.model: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：N=900 kN; u=45 kPa; A=12 m2; Neff=N-uA=360 kN。適用邊界：假想單一面上總法向力與均勻孔壓，未計滑動面需求或外水力矩。~Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: N=900 kN; u=45 kPa; A=12 m2; Neff=N-uA=360 kN. Applicable boundary: A hypothetical plane with total normal force and uniform pore pressure; slip demand and external-water moments are excluded.
units.verify: 同步繪製庫水位與坡內測壓管歷線，比較峰值及回落的時間差。量測點須標明高程和濾管位置，再將多點孔壓分布沿假想面積積分，檢查均勻孔壓近似是否掩蓋局部高壓。~Plot reservoir level and slope piezometer histories together to compare peak and recession timing. Identify sensor elevations and screen positions, then integrate multiple pressures over the hypothetical plane to test whether a uniform approximation hides locally retained pressure.
units.failure: 以當日庫水位直接替代土體孔壓，會錯誤假設內外同步排水；水位已低但孔壓仍高時，這種代換可能高估有效力而低估降水位後的暫態不利狀態。~Replacing internal pore pressure with that day's reservoir level assumes instantaneous drainage. When the reservoir has fallen but soil pressure remains high, this substitution overstates effective force and hides an adverse transient condition.
units.misconception: 庫水位下降時土內孔壓一定立即等幅下降~Internal pore pressure always falls immediately by the same amount as reservoir level
units.practice: 另設孔壓只降低十千帕，重算有效力並比較完全排水的極端，指出還需要哪些強度試驗與時程資料，才能把受力示範延伸到坡面穩定分析。~Reduce pore pressure by only ten kilopascals, recalculate effective force and compare with a fully drained extreme. Identify strength tests and time-history data needed before extending the illustration into slope stability analysis.

units.anchor: 地震慣性力的受力帳~Seismic inertia force bookkeeping
units.title: 地震慣性力的受力帳~Seismic inertia force bookkeeping
units.mechanism: 地震加速度使壩體質量產生慣性力，簡化水平係數乘重量可建立靜力等效的受力帳。這個係數無因次，不應與以公尺每秒平方表示的加速度混用。土石壩實際反應還包括動態放大、孔壓增加、永久位移及材料非線性，所以等效力只是受力討論的初步起點。~Earthquake acceleration produces inertial force in the embankment mass. A dimensionless horizontal coefficient times weight gives a static-equivalent force for bookkeeping and must not be confused with acceleration in metres per second squared. Actual response also involves amplification, pore-pressure generation, permanent displacement and nonlinear soil behavior, making this equivalent force a starting point rather than a complete site-specific seismic performance assessment.
units.model: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：kh=0.15; W=24000 kN; Fh=kh W=3600 kN。適用邊界：無因次係數為假想值，只求等效水平慣性力，未選定設計地震。~Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: kh=0.15; W=24000 kN; Fh=kh W=3600 kN. Applicable boundary: The coefficient is hypothetical and dimensionless; only equivalent horizontal inertia is calculated, without selecting a design earthquake.
units.verify: 先由質量乘重力驗證重量單位，再用加速度等於係數乘重力的另一條路徑重算慣性力。畫出作用位置及方向，將孔壓與材料強度列成獨立問題，不把單一係數當作整段地震歷時。~Verify weight from mass times gravity, then independently recover inertia using acceleration equal to the coefficient times gravity. Draw force location and direction, treating pore pressure and strength as separate issues rather than representing a whole earthquake by one coefficient.
units.failure: 把已是重量的量再乘重力會多出一次重力因子；只檢查等效水平力而忽略變形累積，則可能錯把靜力平衡當成壩頂不沉陷或材料不損傷的證據。~Multiplying weight by gravity again introduces an extra gravity factor. Checking equivalent force alone while ignoring accumulated deformation can falsely turn static equilibrium into evidence of no crest settlement or material damage.
units.misconception: 等效水平力計算完成就能排除地震永久變形~Calculating equivalent horizontal force rules out permanent seismic deformation
units.practice: 用係數零點一與零點二比較慣性力，保持同一重量並解釋線性比例，再列出地震頻率內容與土層反應為何不能由這兩個力值推得。~Compare inertia for coefficients of zero point one and zero point two at the same weight. Explain the linear scaling and why neither earthquake frequency content nor soil response follows from these force values.

units.anchor: 泥砂收支與占容轉換~Sediment budget and occupied storage
units.title: 泥砂收支與占容轉換~Sediment budget and occupied storage
units.mechanism: 水庫庫容損失來自留下的固體與孔隙空間，而非單純入庫濃度。先用輸入減輸出得到淨沉積質量，再除以沉積乾容重才能估算占容。乾容重會隨顆粒組成、壓密與時間改變，因此每年相同固體質量不必占據相同體積，庫容測量仍是重要獨立證據。~Reservoir capacity loss depends on retained solids and their pore space rather than inlet concentration alone. Net deposited mass is incoming minus outgoing solids, and dry bulk density converts that mass to occupied volume. Bulk density changes with grading, consolidation and age, so equal annual solid masses need not occupy equal volumes; bathymetric capacity surveys remain an important independent line of evidence.
units.model: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Min=1800000 kg; Mout=600000 kg; rhoDry=1200 kg/m3; Vdep=(Min-Mout)/rhoDry=1000 m3。適用邊界：一時段乾固體收支閉合且密度均勻，未計庫岸崩塌與再懸浮交換。~Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Min=1800000 kg; Mout=600000 kg; rhoDry=1200 kg/m3; Vdep=(Min-Mout)/rhoDry=1000 m3. Applicable boundary: Closed dry-solids balance for one interval with uniform density, excluding bank failures and resuspension exchanges.
units.verify: 將入出庫懸砂與可觀測推移質分開估計，核對每筆質量是乾重還是濕重。以沉積取芯取得乾容重，再與重複水深測量的體積差比較，保留兩者的不確定度及不同測區範圍。~Estimate incoming and outgoing suspended and observable bed loads separately, identifying dry versus wet mass. Obtain dry bulk density from sediment cores and compare with repeated bathymetric volume differences, retaining uncertainty and differences in surveyed coverage.
units.failure: 把濕泥密度當乾容重會低估固體對應占容；若排砂輸出與入流統計期間不同，又可能出現虛假的負沉積，誤認庫容已恢復而其實只是資料不同步。~Using wet-mud density as dry bulk density understates occupied volume. Mismatched inlet and outlet accounting periods can create false negative deposition, suggesting recovered capacity when the records are merely asynchronous.
units.misconception: 入庫泥砂總質量全部等於當期永久庫容損失~All incoming sediment mass equals permanent capacity loss in that period
units.practice: 把乾容重改為九百與一千五百公斤每立方公尺，計算占容範圍並比較質量不確定度，說明為何單報一個庫容損失數字可能缺乏意義。~Use dry bulk densities of nine hundred and fifteen hundred kilograms per cubic metre to bracket occupied volume. Compare this sensitivity with mass uncertainty and explain why one unqualified capacity-loss number can mislead.

units.anchor: 取水孔口的局部流量~Local intake orifice discharge
units.title: 取水孔口的局部流量~Local intake orifice discharge
units.mechanism: 不同高程取水口能選擇不同水層，但流量仍受水頭、孔口面積及收縮損失影響。理想速度由能量式產生，再以流量係數修正局部三維流動。係數與開口形狀、邊緣及上下游條件有關，不能把另一設備的係數直接搬來代表石門現地真實取水口的校準結果。~Withdrawal elevation selects a water layer, while flow still depends on head, opening area and contraction losses. An energy-based ideal velocity is corrected by a discharge coefficient representing local three-dimensional effects. That coefficient depends on edge shape, geometry and upstream and downstream conditions, so a value assumed here cannot be transferred directly to a real Shihmen intake or another differently shaped installed structure.
units.model: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Cd=0.62; A=1.5 m2; g=9.81 m/s2; dh=6 m; Q=Cd A sqrt(2g dh)=10.09039 m3/s。適用邊界：自由出流的假想孔口，水頭取孔口中心且不計下游淹沒。~Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Cd=0.62; A=1.5 m2; g=9.81 m/s2; dh=6 m; Q=Cd A sqrt(2g dh)=10.09039 m3/s. Applicable boundary: A hypothetical freely discharging orifice with head referenced to its center and no downstream submergence.
units.verify: 以量水槽或校準流量計求實際流量，再對多個水頭反算係數，檢查是否維持穩定。記錄孔口中心高程與下游水位，若變成淹沒出流，應重新定義壓差而不是沿用自由出流水頭。~Measure actual discharge using a calibrated device, infer the coefficient over several heads and test its consistency. Record opening-center elevation and downstream level; if submerged, redefine the pressure difference instead of retaining the free-discharge head.
units.failure: 把水面到孔口底部的距離當中心水頭會造成幾何偏差；出口被尾水淹沒後仍用單側水深，則高估可用壓差，導致流量與質量平衡同時失準。~Referencing head to the opening bottom instead of its center introduces geometric bias. After submergence, using upstream depth alone overstates the available pressure difference and corrupts both discharge and mass balance.
units.misconception: 孔口流量與水頭成正比而不是平方根關係~Orifice discharge is proportional to head rather than its square root
units.practice: 將水頭增為原值四倍，預測並計算流量倍率，再另列流量係數不變的假設，說明若下游水位同時上升，應如何改寫有效水頭。~Increase head fourfold and calculate the discharge multiplier, explicitly retaining constant coefficient. Explain how the effective head must be rewritten if downstream water level rises at the same time.

units.anchor: 排砂時段的固體輸出~Solids export during sluicing
units.title: 排砂時段的固體輸出~Solids export during sluicing
units.mechanism: 排砂效果需要同時知道水量及攜帶固體濃度，只有閘門開度或水流聲音無法衡量輸出。以乾固體質量率積分可比較排砂時段，並與用水量分開記錄。高濃度時顆粒交互作用可能改變流變，簡單稀薄懸浮假設及採樣代表性與乾重定義都需要仔細檢查。~Sediment export requires both water discharge and carried solids concentration; gate position or visible turbulence alone cannot measure it. Integrating dry-solids flux compares sluicing intervals while keeping water consumption in a separate account. At high concentrations, particle interaction may alter rheology, so dilute-suspension assumptions and sampling representativeness need examination before the simple mass calculation is interpreted as operational performance.
units.model: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Q=9 m3/s; C=8 kg/m3; dt=2400 s; M=Q C dt/1000=172.8 tonne。適用邊界：流量與代表濃度固定四十分鐘，質量為乾固體，不宣稱沉積全被移除。~Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Q=9 m3/s; C=8 kg/m3; dt=2400 s; M=Q C dt/1000=172.8 tonne. Applicable boundary: Constant representative discharge and concentration for forty minutes; mass is dry solids, without claiming complete deposit removal.
units.verify: 採樣與流量計必須共用時間區間，對洪砂脈衝增加取樣密度，並標示截面代表方式。把輸出質量與對應放流水量同時報告，再與排砂前後地形比較，避免把輸砂通過誤認為庫底完全清除。~Synchronize sampling and discharge intervals, increase sampling density during pulses and state cross-section representation. Report exported mass alongside water volume and compare with before-and-after bed surveys rather than equating transported material with complete bed clearance.
units.failure: 濃度峰值若只維持短時間卻被乘整段放流歷時，會誇大排砂量；取樣管堵塞則可能反向低估粗粒部分，讓看似穩定的濃度紀錄缺少主要固體。~Multiplying a brief concentration peak by the entire release duration exaggerates export. A blocked sampler can instead miss coarse material, producing a smooth-looking concentration record that omits important solids.
units.misconception: 只要放流水量大就能保證排出的泥砂很多~A large water release guarantees a large exported sediment mass
units.practice: 將前後兩個二十分鐘的濃度分設為十二與四公斤每立方公尺，積分質量並比較平均法，再討論流量也改變時需要怎樣的同步資料。~Assign concentrations of twelve and four kilograms per cubic metre to consecutive twenty-minute intervals, integrate export and compare with averaging. Explain the synchronized data needed if discharge changes as well.

units.anchor: 後池吸收放流變化~Afterbay absorption of release changes
units.title: 後池吸收放流變化~Afterbay absorption of release changes
units.mechanism: 後池可暫存上游放流與下游需求之間的差額，降低短時流量波動傳遞。它不是增加總水量的來源，所有暫存都必須在後續時段釋放或保留成庫存。比較容量時應使用可用水位範圍對應的容積，而非整座後池總容量，並明確保留時段開始時的初始蓄量位置。~An afterbay temporarily stores the difference between upstream release and downstream demand, reducing transmission of short-term fluctuations. It creates no additional water; stored volume must later be released or remain as inventory. Capacity comparison must use the volume available within the relevant level range rather than gross basin capacity, while retaining the initial storage position and the duration of subsequent recovery periods.
units.model: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Qin=18 m3/s; Qout=11 m3/s; dt=2700 s; dV=(Qin-Qout)dt=18900 m3。適用邊界：四十五分鐘恒定差額、無其他入流與蒸發，未指定實際後池容量。~Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Qin=18 m3/s; Qout=11 m3/s; dt=2700 s; dV=(Qin-Qout)dt=18900 m3. Applicable boundary: Constant imbalance for forty-five minutes with other inflows and evaporation omitted, without specifying actual afterbay capacity.
units.verify: 由水位容積曲線計算時段起迄蓄量，與流量差積分互相比較，檢查流量計延遲及回水影響。把下一時段回復所需的出入流差也畫上圖，確認緩衝不是靠不斷累積水量維持。~Calculate endpoint storage from the level-volume curve and compare with integrated flow imbalance, checking meter lag and backwater effects. Plot the subsequent imbalance needed for recovery to confirm that buffering does not depend on indefinitely accumulating water.
units.failure: 把後池總容積當作每次都能使用的空間，忽略已有蓄水及水位限制；連續多次脈衝若未恢復，會逐漸耗盡緩衝，即使每次單獨計算都小於總容量。~Using gross volume as newly available space ignores existing storage and level constraints. Repeated pulses without recovery progressively consume buffering capacity even when every individual pulse is smaller than the gross basin volume.
units.misconception: 每次脈衝都可以重新使用整座後池總容量~Every new pulse can reuse the entire gross afterbay capacity
units.practice: 設定可用空間只有兩萬立方公尺，計算一次脈衝後剩餘空間，再增加第二次脈衝並求中間必須恢復的水量，將初始狀態畫入水量帳。~Set available space to twenty thousand cubic metres, calculate the remainder after one pulse and add a second pulse. Determine the intervening recovery volume and include the initial state explicitly in the account.

units.anchor: 排水量的水頭正規化~Head-normalized drainage conductance
units.title: 排水量的水頭正規化~Head-normalized drainage conductance
units.mechanism: 排水量隨庫水頭變化並不必然表示滲流通道劣化，先以水頭差正規化可比較近似達西條件下的導水能力。這個比值仍受降雨入滲、溫度黏度及出口堵塞影響；用石門土石壩背景討論趨勢時，應把量測位置、時滯與水頭定義清楚保留在完整趨勢圖上。~Drainage increasing with reservoir head does not necessarily indicate deterioration. Dividing flow by head difference compares apparent conductance under roughly Darcy conditions. The ratio remains sensitive to rainfall infiltration, temperature-dependent viscosity and outlet blockage, so trend interpretation must retain measurement location, lag and the definition of hydraulic head rather than presenting one normalized value as a direct measure of erosion or structural condition.
units.model: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Q=0.004 m3/s; dh=20 m; G=Q/dh=0.0002 m2/s。適用邊界：單一路徑近似穩態，排除降雨脈衝與出口回水；不是滲透係數本身。~Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Q=0.004 m3/s; dh=20 m; G=Q/dh=0.0002 m2/s. Applicable boundary: One approximately steady path excluding rainfall pulses and outlet backwater; conductance is not permeability itself.
units.verify: 將流量與對應時滯後的水頭配對，先標記雨期與清理排水溝日期，再比較乾天穩態區段。以水溫修正黏度影響時保留修正前曲線，並同步檢查排水濁度與細粒是否出現。~Pair discharge with appropriately lagged head, marking rain periods and drain-cleaning dates before comparing dry steady intervals. Retain uncorrected curves when adjusting for viscosity and examine turbidity and any transported fine particles alongside apparent conductance changes.
units.failure: 出口堵塞可使量到的排水量降低卻讓內部孔壓升高，不能把低流量一律視為改善；相反地雨水混入排水溝會提高比值，但不一定代表心層發生新的滲流通道。~Outlet blockage may lower measured drainage while raising internal pressure, so reduced flow is not automatically improvement. Rainwater entering a drain can raise apparent conductance without creating a new path through the core.
units.misconception: 排水量降低一定表示壩內滲流風險下降~Lower measured drainage always means reduced internal seepage risk
units.practice: 設水頭增至二十五公尺而導水能力不變，預測流量，再加入固定雨水流入求表觀比值，展示如何用乾雨時段分組避免錯誤判讀。~Increase head to twenty-five metres at unchanged conductance and predict flow, then add a fixed rainfall contribution and compute apparent conductance. Demonstrate how separating dry and wet periods prevents a misleading trend interpretation.
